request.description: I have successfully navigated to member 1042381's detail page, which shows Personal Information (Member No., Status, Full Name, DOB, SSN, Address, Phone, Email) and Account Summary (Open Accounts, Active CCs, Credit Score, Income, Notes). However, the SWIFT code field is not visible in the accessibility tree. The page appears to only display personal and account summary information, with no banking details like SWIFT code, routing numbers, or international wire information. The page may be incomplete, the SWIFT code may be on a different page/tab, or this member may not have SWIFT code information available. I need human guidance to locate where SWIFT codes are stored in this system.
request.current_step: Looking for SWIFT code on member detail page
request.suggested_action: Check if there is a different section, tab, or page in the Bank Suite application where SWIFT codes or international banking details are displayed for members. Alternatively, verify if SWIFT codes are only available for certain types of members or accounts.
request.goal: Look up member 1042381 and read their SWIFT code
